jobs.description:
**Recruiting Coordinator**  

  

**COMPANY DESCRIPTION**
  

Unio Health Partners (UHP) is a highly differentiated physician practice management platform with the goal of transforming care delivery across the Western United States. UHP partners with leading physician practices, creating a cohesive, quality\-oriented clinical culture and facilitating best practice sharing across the platform. Our affiliated practices gain access to a broader suite of services, providing a meaningful benefit to both physicians and patients. UHP's best\-in\-class clinical program covers three sub\-specialties (urology, gastroenterology, and radiation oncology) and offers numerous ancillary services, including pathology lab, in\-office dispensing, and chronic care management. We are led by a highly accomplished management team and provide a full suite of management services to its affiliated practices. UHP is currently affiliated with 182 providers consisting of 119 physicians and 63 advanced practice providers operating out of 54 locations across Southern, Central, and Northern California.
  

  

**Position Summary**
  

The Recruiting Coordinator supports Unio Specialty Care's talent acquisition efforts by managing the day\-to\-day logistics of the recruitment lifecycle — from sourcing and initial candidate contact through credentialing and onboarding. This role is ideal for a detail\-oriented, organized professional who thrives in a fast\-paced, collaborative environment and is eager to help build the clinical and administrative teams at an industry\-leading specialty care organization.

**Candidates must live in Southern California**
  

  

**What you will be doing**
* Manage job postings and maintain recruitment channels across job boards and platforms
* Support outreach to fellowship and residency programs to build the physician and APP talent pipeline
* Coordinate candidate credentialing documentation and requirements throughout the hiring process
* Administer candidate surveys at the pre\-interview, post\-interview, and onboarding stages
* Track and maintain recruitment data and metrics to support reporting and process improvement
* Conduct initial candidate screening and outreach
* Manage candidate communications and outreach cadence to ensure a timely, positive candidate experience

  

**What you will bring to the team**
* Bachelor’s degree in human resources, Business Administration, Healthcare Administration, or a related field preferred; equivalent experience considered
* 1–2 years of experience in recruiting, talent acquisition, HR coordination, or a related administrative role; healthcare or physician recruiting experience a plus
* Live in SoCal
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple candidates and priorities simultaneously
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* High attention to detail, particularly with credentialing documentation and compliance requirements
* Proficiency with applicant tracking systems (ATS), job boards, and Microsoft Office
* Ability to maintain confidentiality and exercise sound judgment with sensitive candidate and employee information
* Comfortable working both independently and collaboratively in a fast\-paced environment

  

**What we can offer you**
* Competitive Salary and Health Benefits (Medical, Dental, Vision)
* Generous time off (start accruing on your first day \- no waiting period)
* Paid Holidays
* 401(k)
* Company Discounts
* Collaborative work environment \- we want our employees to have a say in how we run our office
* Employee Recognition

jobs.title: Assistant Project Manager
jobs.description:
**FullTerra / Clean Vapor**
===========================


**Assistant Project Manager**
-----------------------------


**Location:** Atlanta, GA, with travel to job sites throughout the Atlanta metro area


**Job Type:** Full\-Time, Exempt


### **Build Your Career in Environmental Construction**



Clean Vapor, a FullTerra company, is a specialty contractor providing vapor intrusion mitigation installation services for commercial and residential properties throughout the Atlanta market.



We are looking for an **Assistant Project Manager** to support the planning, coordination, and execution of vapor intrusion mitigation projects. You will work closely with Project Managers, field crews, subcontractors, clients, and trade partners to help ensure projects are completed safely, on schedule, and according to project requirements.



This is an excellent opportunity for someone with construction or environmental project experience who wants to grow into a Project Manager role within a specialized area of the environmental construction industry.


### **What You'll Do**


**Project Coordination**


* Assist Project Managers with the day\-to\-day coordination of vapor intrusion mitigation installations, including sub\-slab depressurization systems, vapor barriers, and sub\-membrane venting
* Coordinate field crews, subcontractors, equipment, and material deliveries
* Help keep multiple active projects organized and on schedule
* Participate in client meetings and provide project progress updates
* Serve as an on\-site point of contact for subcontractors and trade partners during installation


**Plans, Documentation \& Compliance**


* Review site plans, system layouts, specifications, and approved designs
* Help verify installations are completed according to project requirements and applicable standards
* Maintain project documentation, including submittals, RFIs, punch lists, photo logs, and closeout packages
* Assist with permitting, site access agreements, and coordination with property owners and facility managers
* Support OSHA requirements and site\-specific health and safety plans


**Budgeting \& Estimating**


* Track project budgets, change orders, and daily field reports
* Identify and communicate potential scope or cost deviations to the Project Manager
* Prepare quantity takeoffs and assist with estimating for future projects as needed

### **What You Bring**


**Required Qualifications**


* 1\-3\+ years of experience in construction project coordination, environmental remediation, or a related field
* Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Environmental Science, Engineering, or equivalent relevant experience
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple active projects
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, including Excel and Outlook
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Valid driver's license and ability to travel to job sites throughout the Atlanta metro area
* OSHA 10 or OSHA 30 certification, or willingness to obtain certification within 90 days of hire


**Preferred Qualifications**


* Experience with vapor intrusion or vapor mitigation projects
* Knowledge of vapor intrusion mitigation systems and methods, including sub\-slab depressurization, vapor barriers, and sub\-membrane depressurization
* Familiarity with ASTM E2121 and applicable state or EPA vapor intrusion guidance
* Experience using Bluebeam, Procore, Microsoft Project, or similar construction/project management software

### **Physical \& Work Requirements**


* Ability to visit and work around active construction and installation sites
* Ability to access areas such as residential crawlspaces, commercial slabs, mechanical spaces, and below\-grade areas while using appropriate PPE
* Comfortable working around slab penetration equipment and mechanical fans
* Ability to lift approximately 25\-40 lbs
* Ability to stand or walk for extended periods during site visits

### **What You'll Get**


* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* Company\-matched 401(k) retirement plan
* Paid vacation and paid holidays
* Vehicle/mileage allowance for travel between job sites
* Professional development support
* Opportunity to grow into a full Project Manager role

### **Join Clean Vapor**



If you're an organized, detail\-oriented construction or environmental professional looking to develop your project management career, we'd like to hear from you.


*FullTerra / Clean Vapor is an equal opportunity employer.*

Location: Chicago, IL  
Company: Evolve

Are you looking to break into marketing and events but don’t know where to start?

Evolv is currently hiring a Junior Marketing Assistant (Events) to join our Chicago team. This role is perfect for someone who enjoys working with people, thrives in a fast\-paced environment, and wants to gain hands\-on experience promoting brands at live events and activations.

Please note: This is a full\-time, on\-site position. Candidates must be able to commute to our Chicago location daily. Remote work is not available.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Support the delivery of engaging marketing campaigns at events, pop\-ups, and retail locations
* Interact with customers in a professional and approachable way to build brand awareness
* Share product knowledge and answer customer questions confidently
* Assist with event setup, coordination, and execution alongside the team
* Monitor individual performance and contribute to team targets and campaign success

**What We Offer**

* Weekly earnings with performance incentives — typical OTE ranges from $750–$1,350\+ per week
* Additional bonuses, team incentives, and recognition programs
* Structured training designed to build your marketing and communication skills
* Opportunities for career progression into team leadership and management roles
* A supportive, team\-oriented culture with ongoing mentorship
* The chance to work across different event locations and campaigns

On top of this we offer access to a company\-supported wellness program, with gym membership discounts and resources that support your physical performance and day\-to\-day energy!

**About You**

* Friendly, confident, and comfortable engaging with new people
* Self\-motivated and driven to achieve personal and team goals
* Reliable, proactive, and eager to learn
* Interested in developing a long\-term career in marketing, events, or sales

**Experience**

**FullTerra / Clean Vapor**
===========================


**Assistant Project Manager**
-----------------------------


**Location:** Atlanta, GA, with travel to job sites throughout the Atlanta metro area


**Job Type:** Full\-Time, Exempt


### **Build Your Career in Environmental Construction**



Clean Vapor, a FullTerra company, is a specialty contractor providing vapor intrusion mitigation installation services for commercial and residential properties throughout the Atlanta market.



We are looking for an **Assistant Project Manager** to support the planning, coordination, and execution of vapor intrusion mitigation projects. You will work closely with Project Managers, field crews, subcontractors, clients, and trade partners to help ensure projects are completed safely, on schedule, and according to project requirements.

* Coordinate field crews, subcontractors, equipment, and material deliveries
* Help keep multiple active projects organized and on schedule
* Participate in client meetings and provide project progress updates
* Serve as an on\-site point of contact for subcontractors and trade partners during installation


**Plans, Documentation \& Compliance**


* Review site plans, system layouts, specifications, and approved designs
* Help verify installations are completed according to project requirements and applicable standards
* Maintain project documentation, including submittals, RFIs, punch lists, photo logs, and closeout packages
* Assist with permitting, site access agreements, and coordination with property owners and facility managers
* Support OSHA requirements and site\-specific health and safety plans


**Budgeting \& Estimating**


* Track project budgets, change orders, and daily field reports
* Identify and communicate potential scope or cost deviations to the Project Manager
* Prepare quantity takeoffs and assist with estimating for future projects as needed

### **What You Bring**


**Required Qualifications**


* 1\-3\+ years of experience in construction project coordination, environmental remediation, or a related field
* Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Environmental Science, Engineering, or equivalent relevant experience
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple active projects
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, including Excel and Outlook
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Valid driver's license and ability to travel to job sites throughout the Atlanta metro area
* OSHA 10 or OSHA 30 certification, or willingness to obtain certification within 90 days of hire


**Preferred Qualifications**


* Experience with vapor intrusion or vapor mitigation projects
* Knowledge of vapor intrusion mitigation systems and methods, including sub\-slab depressurization, vapor barriers, and sub\-membrane depressurization
* Familiarity with ASTM E2121 and applicable state or EPA vapor intrusion guidance
* Experience using Bluebeam, Procore, Microsoft Project, or similar construction/project management software

### **Physical \& Work Requirements**


* Ability to visit and work around active construction and installation sites
* Ability to access areas such as residential crawlspaces, commercial slabs, mechanical spaces, and below\-grade areas while using appropriate PPE
* Comfortable working around slab penetration equipment and mechanical fans
* Ability to lift approximately 25\-40 lbs
* Ability to stand or walk for extended periods during site visits

### **What You'll Get**


* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* Company\-matched 401(k) retirement plan
* Paid vacation and paid holidays
* Vehicle/mileage allowance for travel between job sites
* Professional development support
* Opportunity to grow into a full Project Manager role

### **Join Clean Vapor**



If you're an organized, detail\-oriented construction or environmental professional looking to develop your project management career, we'd like to hear from you.


*FullTerra / Clean Vapor is an equal opportunity employer.*
